name: improve-codebase-architecture
title_zh: 扫出代码里该深挖的模块，再陪你把它聊透
tagline_zh: 架构债不是靠通读代码发现的。它先扫出几处「这里再深一层会好很多」的候选，做成一份能点的 HTML 报告；你挑一个。
tagline_en: Architecture debt isn't found by reading everything. It scans for a few 'this deserves a deeper module'.
desc_en: Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities, present them as a visual HTML report, then grill through whichever one you pick.
why_zh: 先给候选再逼你选，而不是一次性甩一份重构清单。追问环节逼你把「为什么这样切」说清楚。
why_en: It offers candidates, then makes you choose. The grilling forces you to articulate why this seam, not just what to change.
limit_zh: 只产出报告和对话，不改一行代码、不跑测试、不验证方案可行性；扫的是结构信号，业务语义上的深挖机会它看不出来，得你自己补。
limit_en: Produces a report and dialogue only — no code edits, no tests, no feasibility checks. It reads structural signals, not business semantics.
title_en: Find the modules worth deepening, then grill you through one
